propositions: Default fsck and compact-all scans visit only active (non-archived) tickets using a shared _ticket_dirs iterator with marker fast-path and _is_net_archived confirmation, reducing O(all tickets) walk time as store grows

Archive operation performs inline terminal fold (reusing compact_cli with threshold=0/horizon=0) before writing ARCHIVED event, ensuring folded tickets carry no unfolded events and eliminating sole fold burden from later compact-all runs
Both fsck and compact-all expose --include-archived flag to restore full-store walk for deep audits and legacy archived-but-unfolded ticket folding
Reverted-archive tickets (stale marker but no net-archived state) remain visited by default because confirmation step, not marker alone, decides archival status
Store-wide metrics (_check_json_validity, _check_create_events) always traverse all dirs; active-only scoping affects only which findings are reported
